test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 22 Jan 2021 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Which two rivers are linked by the Pattiseema Lift Irrigation Project?
solution:
The correct answer is **Godavari and Krishna**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **Pattiseema Lift Irrigation Project** is designed to divert water from the **Godavari River** to the **Krishna River**.
 
• This project aims to utilize surplus water from the Godavari to address water scarcity in the Krishna basin.
 
• It is a key initiative to improve irrigation and water supply in Andhra Pradesh.
 
• The project is one of the first river interlinking projects in India.

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__**

 
 

 Option
 Details
 
 

 Option 1
 Godavari and Narmada: No major interlinking projects between these two rivers.
 
 

 Option 2
 Godavari and Cauvery: There are discussions but no implemented projects linking these rivers.
 
 

 Option 3
 Godavari and Mahanadi: These rivers are part of different river interlinking proposals but not linked by the Pattiseema project.
